OpenMetrics output mode: output information that can be scraped by OpenMetrics-compatible services. Implies batch mode. By combining with any of `-l`, `-k` and `-w` you can decide whether the metrics will expose outdated libraries, kernel and microcode, respectively.

When checking running interpreter processes, allow process start times that are close to timestamps of files the interpreter uses, within this tolerance (default 2). The default value of 2 seconds is best for checks of Linux hosts, on which system limitations prevent more accurate measurements of process start times.
